description: SaaS / app launch briefs for commercial.feature-launch: two complete, one with a quoted CTA and look, one that lacks the product name and call to action.

briefs.brief: Launch video for Ledgerly, bookkeeping for freelancers. Features: snap a receipt and it files itself, invoices chase late payers automatically, and you get a nudge before a tax deadline. Call to action: Start free

Launch film for Quayside, a shared inbox for small support teams. Every customer email lands in one queue, you assign a conversation with one click, and you get alerted when a reply is overdue. Call to action: "Try Quayside free". Light, clean look, calm music.

Product launch for Sproutline, an app that monitors home greenhouses: charts of soil moisture over the week, automatic watering you switch on per bed, and alerts when frost is forecast. Call to action: Join the beta. Green look.
We are launching our new project management app next month. It has Kanban boards, automatic time tracking and Slack alerts. Make it slick.
briefs.note: No product name and no call to action; both slots are verbatim, so the writer must report them missing.
